verdict.rationale: The evidence implies a serverless, usage-metered model, but it never documents the pricing structure or any per-unit rates. Multi-tenant is the default deployment (docs-3), and reserved compute via namespace pinning is an opt-in alternative to the default (docs-26). Marking attributes `filterable: false` earns a 50% discount (docs-29), which suggests metered, per-attribute billing, and the homepage claims the product is '10x cheaper' (docs-38). Missing for 10: an explicit pricing page with transparent per-unit costs (writes, queries, storage), explicit confirmation that billing is usage-based with no cluster provisioning, and independent corroboration of the pricing model.
